target_customer: Marketers and small businesses that need finished video or static ads quickly
problem: Producing ads takes agencies or editors time and money; Polished generated finished ads from a brief and let users refine them in plain English.
business_model: SaaS subscription for AI ad generation (pricing not found)

competitors.name: AdCreative.ai
competitors.what: AI generator of conversion-focused static ads from a website scan or brief
competitors.source_date: 2021 (founding year, stated in a 2026 comparison page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating image and video generation models and an editing loop by chat; relies on third party models available in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: Thin application layer on third party models; many rivals shipped near identical tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms added their own AI ad creative features; no specific dated action cited in sources opened.

market_need_then: Advertisers needed cheaper creative; generative models made automated ad creation feasible in 2023, and several rivals launched. No hard demand data found for Polished itself.

branding.domain_note: Used polished.ad (the .ad TLD, which returned 404 at last check).

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence for the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Polished joined YC in Winter 2024 with an AI ad generator in a crowded category and its website now returns 404. Funding and traction are unknown, so no outcome judgment can be made beyond stalled visibility.
